1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea perenne, trepadora, de hojas compuestas y flores rosáceas cuyo fruto es una legumbre comprimida. (Fabaceae, Vigna vexillata).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial climbing herb with compound leaves and rose-like flowers whose fruit is a compressed legume (Fabaceae, Vigna vexillata).
